assertion.statement: The actual unramified coefficient module at a derivative place has the displayed arithmetic-Frobenius small complex [M -> M plus M -> M], with maps (Phi-1,0) and (0,Phi-q); H12 makes its differentials vanish at the retained precision.
assertion.objects: The actual derivative-place module M, q=ell^2 and arithmetic Frobenius Phi.
assertion.hypotheses: ell is odd and distinct from coefficient prime2; M is unramified at this good derivative place, with trivial local coefficient character. H12 supplies Phi=1 and q=1 at the retained exponent.
assertion.quantifiers: Each retained derivative place and finite exponent m<=a.
assertion.parameter_range: Exactly the actual good derivative places and finite coefficient modules.
assertion.uniformity: Compatible with coefficient reductions because the change of basis is given by the invertible Frobenius operator.
assertion.constants: No divisions by q-1,2,or a group order.
assertion.normalizations: Put f=Phi^-1. With t=1 the source maps are (Phi^-1-1,0) and (0,q Phi^-1-1). The change of basis is identity in degree0, diag(-Phi,1) in degree1 and -Phi in degree2.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Formal comparison of the small complex does not establish the later cup self-products, transfer shear cancellation, or all local-condition homotopies.
assertion.limit_order: Apply the published tame complex, change the geometric Frobenius convention by the explicit chain isomorphism, then apply H12 at retained precision.

use.reason: Supplies the actual local small model with explicit geometric-to-arithmetic Frobenius conversion.

supplier.statement: The tame local three-term small complex computes continuous cohomology, with functorial comparison maps whose composite on the small complex is the identity.
